title: Assessing the Level of Toxicity Against Distinct Groups in Bangla Social Media Comments: A Comprehensive Investigation

bias_targets.methodology: Creating a multi-level annotated dataset of Bangla social media comments targeting transgender people and classifying their toxicity levels (low, medium, high) using pre-trained transformer models like Bangla-BERT.

Compiling and annotating Bangla comments that perpetuate harmful stereotypes, mock, or belittle indigenous/tribal people, and evaluating the classification performance of various language models on these texts.

Collecting and categorizing hostility and prejudice directed at migrant populations in Bangla social media comments, then assessing the accuracy of transformer models in detecting the severity of these toxic remarks.
